title: Fantastic Quaternions - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile's James Grime introduces quaternions, a type of number beyond the complex numbers, building up from real and complex numbers and explaining why they are useful.
why: HN recommends it as the simplest, most approachable introduction to quaternions, useful for people working in games and robotics.

quote.text: Numberphile's explanation of Quaternions is the simplest I have seen so far
